land_pattern.package: 20-Lead Plastic Shrink Small Outline (SS) - 5.30 mm Body [SSOP], Microchip Technology Drawing No. C04-2072B
land_pattern.notes: From the RECOMMENDED LAND PATTERN drawing on p.39 (Microchip Technology Drawing No. C04-2072B), MILLIMETERS: Contact Pitch E = 0.65 BSC; Contact Pad Spacing C = 7.20 (NOM column); Contact Pad Width (X20) X1 = 0.45 (MAX column); Contact Pad Length (X20) Y1 = 1.75 (MAX column); Distance Between Pads G = 0.20 (MIN column). Note 1: dimensioning and tolerancing per ASME Y14.5M. Self-consistency check: X1 0.45 + G 0.20 = pitch 0.65 - correct. C = 7.20 is the pad-row CENTRE-to-CENTRE spacing (outer span would then be 7.20 + 1.75 = 8.95 mm and the inner gap 7.20 - 1.75 = 5.45 mm, which straddles the 5.30 mm nominal molded body width E1 and the 7.80 mm nominal lead-tip span E - an outer-edge reading would put the pads under the package body and is wrong). pad_size_mm is [X1 width, Y1 length]. Courtyard excess is NOT stated by the drawing. Pins 1-10 run down the left side and 11-20 up the right side (Package Types figure, p.2). Package outline for reference (C04-072B, p.38, mm min/nom/max): N = 20, pitch e = 0.65 BSC, overall height A max 2.00, molded package thickness A2 1.65/1.75/1.85, standoff A1 min 0.05, overall width E 7.40/7.80/8.20, molded package width E1 5.00/5.30/5.60, overall length D 6.90/7.20/7.50, foot length L 0.55/0.75/0.95, footprint L1 1.25 REF, lead thickness c 0.09/-/0.25, foot angle 0/4/8 deg, lead width b 0.22/-/0.38.
